front.title: Subscriber-Side Multi-Variant Fast Track Switching for MOQT

abstract.t: This document describes subscriber-side multi-variant fast track switching (MVFTS), a technique that allows a MOQ Transport (MOQT) subscriber to switch between tracks that are encoded at the same bitrate but use different group of pictures (GoP) lengths, combining the compression efficiency of a long GoP with the low switching delay of a short GoP. A publisher using this technique packages each encoded bitrate as a ladder of tracks distinguished only by their keyframe interval, numbers those tracks' Group IDs so that they share a common alignment, and advertises the keyframe interval of each track in a MOQT Streaming Format (MSF) catalog. A subscriber uses this information to compute the nearest valid switch point on any track in scope and to perform the switch using the SWITCH_FROM request parameter in soft mode.
